title: groundgate candidate, spec 0.7
description: One extracted value with its evidence (SPEC.md section 2.5). Step 1 of SPEC.md section 3 is the definition. This schema does not check that a ref names a reference in the packet, that no two document or reference items have the same role, or that an integer has no fraction (2.0).

id.description: The caller's identifier, echoed in the decision. A string or an integer.

value.description: The value: a string, or a JSON integer. Write a number with a fraction as a decimal string.

unit.description: The unit code that the extractor claims.

key.description: For a keyed field, the key that the value belongs to.

evidence.description: The evidence items. One item object counts as a list that holds it.

search_region.description: The span in which re-anchoring can look. Default: the whole document.

span.description: UTF-8 byte offsets, end exclusive (SPEC.md section 2.2).

item.description: One piece of support for the value (SPEC.md sections 2.5 and 4.6).

source.description: Where the text comes from. Default: document.

text.description: The quoted text. For knowledge, the extractor's statement.

ref.description: The id of a reference in the packet.

retrieved.description: The date that the extractor read the page.

checked.description: A document or reference item: offsets, a quote, or both.

role.description: What the item supports. Default: value.

outside.description: An external or knowledge item: no role and no offsets.
